rows.line: うまくやってる人であればあるほど
rows.en1: The better you're doing, the more careful you get.

rows.line: 周りからこう眉をひそめられるようなこと
rows.en1: stuff that makes people raise an eyebrow

rows.line: あいつは終わったと思われるようなこと
rows.en1: He's done.

rows.line: 一応両方に足を突っ込んでいて
rows.en1: I've got a foot in both worlds.
rows.en2: I kind of live in both.

rows.line: ちょっと極端すぎる二択だなと思っていて
rows.en1: That's way too black and white.

rows.line: 毎年2人ぐらいずつ出てくれば、それはありかって
rows.en1: Then sure, I could see that.

rows.line: ポキッと行くこと、人間あるじゃないですか
rows.en1: People just snap sometimes.

rows.ja: いつ〜てもおかしくない
rows.line: いつ壊れてもおかしくないのかなって
rows.en1: I could break any day.

rows.line: 怖いこと言う
rows.en1: Whoa, that's dark.
rows.en2: Don't say scary stuff like that.

rows.ja: そうなったらなったで
rows.line: そうなったらなったで、それも一つの経験かな
rows.en1: If it happens, it happens.
rows.en2: If it goes that way, fine, that's life.

rows.line: 人生3回目みたいなことで飽きてる
rows.en1: like I've lived this life three times already
rows.en2: like an old soul who's seen it all

rows.line: そういう裏があってほしいですよ
rows.en1: I want there to be a secret side to you.
rows.en2: Come on, tell me there's more to it.

rows.line: 驚くべきことに本当にないんですよ
rows.en1: Believe it or not, nope.

rows.line: 眠くて起こされて軽くキレるとか
rows.en1: I'll get a little snappy if I get woken up.

rows.ja: なんでわかってくれないの
rows.line: なんでわかってくれないのってとか
rows.en1: Why don't you get it?

rows.line: お互いそれぞれ好き勝手やっていけるような状況
rows.en1: We each just do our own thing.
rows.en2: We kind of leave each other alone.

rows.line: ちょっと多分臆病で逃げてるんだって思ってます
rows.en1: I'm probably just scared and running away.
rows.en2: Honestly, I'm kind of chickening out.

rows.line: 逃げてるうちは、ちょっとわかる気がする
rows.en1: I kind of get that.

rows.line: 普通に寂しいなと感じることもありますか
rows.en1: Do you ever just get lonely?
rows.en2: Don't you ever feel lonely, though?

rows.line: 早く行けばよかったと思って
rows.en1: I should've done it way sooner.
rows.en2: Why didn't I do this years ago?

rows.line: 動物という生命体がいればOKだったってことがやっとわかりました
rows.en1: It finally hit me.

rows.line: 100パー今満足です
rows.en1: I'm a hundred percent happy.

rows.line: 職場で多少必要とされてるふりをしてもらって
rows.en1: They at least pretend they need me at work.
rows.en2: People act like they need me.

rows.line: これ計算じゃないんだけどな
rows.en1: I'm not doing it on purpose, though.
rows.en2: This isn't an act, I swear.

rows.ja: 嫌で嫌でしょうがない
rows.line: 嫌で嫌でしょうがなくて泣いたけど
rows.en1: I hated it so much I cried.

rows.line: あれは残酷で、受け入れざるを得ない
rows.en1: It's brutal, but you just have to accept it.
rows.en2: You've got no choice but to deal with it.

rows.line: その自己分析の解像度すごいですよ
rows.en1: You really know yourself inside and out.

rows.line: だって学歴は申し分ないでしょ
rows.en1: Your schooling's flawless.

rows.ja: 気づくと全部忘れてる
rows.line: 気づくと全部忘れてるみたいな
rows.en1: Next thing I know, I've forgotten all of it.

rows.ja: 何を目指してたんだっけ
rows.line: 何を目指してたんだっけみたいな感じ
rows.en1: Wait, what was I going for again?

rows.line: メリットがあるって事にあとから気づいた
rows.en1: I only realized that later.
rows.en2: It hit me after the fact.

rows.line: それみんな気分で語ってるなっていう感じ
rows.en1: Everybody's just going off vibes.
rows.en2: People are just going on gut feeling.

rows.line: テレビ全体として丸くなってるっていう話
rows.en1: TV's gone soft across the board.

rows.line: 政権批判ばっかりしやがってって言われる
rows.en1: All you do is trash the government.

rows.line: 一人本当気骨がある人がいたら
rows.en1: if there's just one person with a backbone
